paragraphs.source_en: Morning mist swirled above the frozen river. White herons stood here and there amid the green fields. Two horses shot past like arrows loosed from the string. Oda Nobunaga led the way, with Maeda Inuchiyo close behind. Inuchiyo was no longer the page he had once been. He had become the heir of Maeda Toshiharu, lord of Arako Castle with a stipend of twenty-two hundred kan, and upon coming of age had taken the name Matazaemon Toshiie.
